calls.title: Keep the browser origin stable
calls.chose: Remember one loopback port per file; rotate the access token on restart.
calls.because: Pending browser checkpoints live under their origin. A new port would leave them unreachable after restarting the review server.
calls.undo: Remove the remembered port file and choose an explicit port.

calls.title: Build the native reader on the current preview
calls.chose: Use an isolated feature branch from the current T3 preview, with its matching private renderer.
calls.because: The current preview contains the newer HTML open path; starting from the older integration branch would omit that working code. Release assignment remains unassigned.
calls.undo: Move the feature commits to the selected integration branch after its base catches up.
